title: Conditional κ = .00387992804505 (+0.0000000409801414405% over #7863): weighted paid exits on the 451-factor multiplier
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ = 0.00387992804505** for deterministic, all-input fixed-multitape integer multiplication under the 451-factor, seven-stage premises of #7863. The strongest independently reproduced external peer is **κ = 0.00387992804346** from #7863 at `b3e4412fe01f07dc58305616fabf96345f49a781`. The exact gain over that peer is **0.00000000000159**, or **0.0000000409801414405%** rounded, exactly `(2650/64665467391)%`. #7973 at `ac3df5d5c8889f464f575e32dfea43714abf08ca` independently replayed the peer’s 451-factor schedule and consumer. Canonical main at `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` separately selects #7000 at κ = 0.00363005817. [Peer construction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7863) · [Independent peer replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7973) · [Maintainer-selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/certificates/selected-result.json)

The last three steps improve the same compiler proof on the same signed word. Together they add **0.00000000000083** over the previously hosted #8026 head at κ = 0.00387992804422, or **0.0000000213921493012%**, exactly `(4150/193996402211)%`. [Previous hosted result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2f82ecc8e3e38cdbd3217a353f0bf5ee2d466c20/research/bit-451-carrier-cover/normalized/ENDPOINT.json)

| Change in this PR | Complete κ | Exact increase over immediate predecessor¹ | Percentage over that predecessor, rounded (exact) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Weighted paid exits, power 45 | 0.00387992804459 | 0.00000000000037 | 0.00000000953625932706% (`1850/193996402211`%) |
| Least power for the first-moment envelope, 32 | 0.00387992804502 | 0.00000000000043 | 0.0000000110826797574% (`4300/387992804459`%) |
| Second-moment envelope, power 31 | **0.00387992804505** | **0.00000000000003** | **0.000000000773210215548%** (`50/64665467417`%) |

¹ The starting value is 0.00387992804422. Each subsequent increase uses the immediately preceding construction.

## What changed

The earlier steps in this PR charge the fallback at the actual carrier, bound the same integer compiler by a fractional logarithmic power, then optimize the integer scale of its normalized power-60 proof. These establish the power-60 predecessor with ordinary loss numerator 2218 at carrier exponent H = 1202400000000000. [Carrier cover](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/355f3218f963be1033a1794073270222adc45d6f/research/bit-451-carrier-cover/PROOF.md) · [Fractional proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/80fcb342be8d0583f8a3f96298a6204318fa848a/research/bit-451-carrier-cover/MAJORANT.md) · [Integer-scale endpoint](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2f82ecc8e3e38cdbd3217a353f0bf5ee2d466c20/research/bit-451-carrier-cover/normalized/ENDPOINT.md)

1. **Power 45.** The literal paid-exit distribution of the separated compiler admits a normalized first moment below 3/4. At scale 1804, all 46 contraction coefficients pass. Stirling expansion and direct Newton differences agree at every coefficient. The loss numerator drops to 1768. Source commit `a24daf62b8e63eabefc62afbc5ad4c73b7216e60`, result SHA-256 `f2218a9eb212ef7f0ae1c993297df50c401bb6b24537318c2570cea54d6d2b92`. [Proof and exact receipt](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/a24daf62b8e63eabefc62afbc5ad4c73b7216e60/research/bit-451-carrier-cover/weighted)
2. **Power 32.** All 33 coefficients pass for the full first-moment envelope. Power 31 fails at height 5. Every normalized realization lies strictly between zero and one, so the same input excludes all smaller positive integer powers for this envelope. The loss numerator drops to 1257. Source commit `1ef5792e7c64de7ced89cc719f7897868f96d076`, result SHA-256 `b8a72fc639fecfe4a815421413ff2d47aa7c65d96b35339285be67c557fbdac5`. [Minimum-power proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ef5792e7c64de7ced89cc719f7897868f96d076/research/bit-451-carrier-cover/weighted/MINIMUM.md) · [Certificate](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ef5792e7c64de7ced89cc719f7897868f96d076/research/bit-451-carrier-cover/weighted/MINIMUM.json)
3. **Power 31.** Independence of the 451 raw tensor factors and the full excess-paid-mass bound give a completed second moment below 3/5. This tighter bound passes the same height-5 control. All 32 Bell-polynomial ratios match the independent convolution and Newton reconstruction, with the largest at index 4. The loss numerator drops to 1218. The new claim clears the preceding proof’s ceiling by exactly `1043/100200000000000000`, even granting it the raw crossing’s upper endpoint, zero cover loss and seven ticks of outer allowance. The raw BIT crossing stays in [0.003879928046154, 0.003879928046155]. [Moment proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/47f5718d033560b984fe49289c9de5023aaf6b08/research/bit-451-carrier-cover/weighted/LOG-MOMENTS.md) · [Exact certificate](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/47f5718d033560b984fe49289c9de5023aaf6b08/research/bit-451-carrier-cover/weighted/SECOND.json)

## Verification

**Local.** Three cold consumer replays took 25.724, 25.723 and 25.798 seconds respectively. The final one consumed the seven-stage BIT cap 0.00387992804513502, tested 0.00387992804512 and left strict headroom 0.00000000000001502. It replayed 48 signed rational calls and 1,661,521 coefficients in each orientation. All 54 strict and four functional conditions passed. An additional paid rank-one term and an insufficient ordinary cap were both rejected. The source-bound supplier replay checks the two native orientations, 3,554 dirty retirements in each, and all 36 signed binary caller uses. Final application SHA-256 is `038a693200287638feae8d6888d4834577e3eb4b2d95cd75ea607605f1c989a0`. Expanded audit SHA-256 is `bf063d3cee7cdde73575265d2e73f430f71dd98abf611bd63cddcbc8ed0e78e1`. [Registered checks](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/47f5718d033560b984fe49289c9de5023aaf6b08/research/bit-451-carrier-cover/VERIFY.json)

**Hosted.** A new registered workflow is pending on this revision. The separate CI prerequisite is from [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257).

## Credit and scope

Jacob Alan Sussman supplied the separated integer lockstep compiler. DreamingOfClouds supplied the ambient-cap construction. zxv’s work supplied the logarithmic majorants, tensor-moment bound and completion proof. JoyboyBrian’s rank-moment and clipping analyses established precedents for using actual rank moments. Clear1nsight supplied the 451-factor schedule, #7830 pricing and #7973 consumer replay. The retained delayed-cover authors supplied the fallback bound, Ali Romman the paired caller and the fixed-law all-height test in [#5351](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5351), Dugongue and Rohan Arun the cutoff schedules, and Cinna Davis earlier outer recovery. This PR applies those results to the fixed #7863 word and verifies their effect on the complete conditional multiplier. OpenAI Codex materially assisted the proof, implementation and independent replays. [Compiler](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4359) · [Logarithmic majorant](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4433) · [Tensor moments](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4480) · [Rank moments](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5042) · [Clipping](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5070) · [Prior pricing](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830)

The result retains the same five premises covering all-column native action, owned erasure, compiler closure, precision and tape, and analytic recovery. The original and nested productive stock must return at all seven stages on the same physical carrier. The result gives the all-size conditional bound under those premises. From a clean checkout of the submitted head, run the registered standard-library replay with CPython 3.12.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-451-carrier-cover
```
